name: claudekeys
description: Session-scoped, encrypted, read-only secrets that Claude uses in commands as {{ck:NAME}} without ever seeing them

retain_hours.title: Keep secrets for (hours)
retain_hours.description: Encrypted secrets of a session nobody has used for this long are deleted. They survive /resume within this window.

show_badge.title: Show the key badge above the prompt
show_badge.description: A right-aligned key with the number of secrets in this session. /keys opens the same pane.
